en: The image on the postcard depicts a monument made of stone and iron chains, set in a wooded area. The monument is a large upright stone with an inscribed plaque and some emblematic reliefs above it. The setting is somewhat solemn, indicating a commemorative or memorial purpose. The front of the postcard bears the text 'Bad Pyrmont' in one corner and 'Königin Luisenstein' in the other, both in ornate script. The reverse side has empty address lines and a printed mark from the 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont', as well as publication information from Otto Fröbel of Bad Pyrmont.
